identity.title: CVE-2026-123991
identity.description: A vulnerability was detected in DataEase up to 2.10.27. Affected by this vulnerability is the function WhitelistUtils.endsWithAny of the file WhitelistUtils.java of the component Authentication Filter. Performing a manipulation of the argument File results in unrestricted upload. It is possible to initiate the attack remotely. The exploit is now public and may be used. Upgrading to version 2.10.28 addresses this issue. It is advisable to upgrade the affected component. The vendor confirms: "This issue has been addressed by enforcing authentication on the standalone static-resource upload endpoint independently of the URI suffix whitelist."

barriers.summary: network, privileges: NONE, user interaction: NONE

cwe_names.CWE-434: Unrestricted Upload of File with Dangerous Type

_relevance.reason: Enterprise BI platform with public exploit for remote unrestricted upload bypassing authentication filter.

identity.title: CVE-2026-123990
identity.description: A security vulnerability has been detected in DataEase up to 2.10.27/3.1.0. Affected is the function ExtWhere2Str.extWhere2sqlOjb of the file engine/trans/ExtWhere2Str.java of the component Chart Data Handler. Such manipulation of the argument operator leads to sql injection. The attack may be performed from remote. The exploit has been disclosed publicly and may be used. Upgrading to version 3.2.0 is able to address this issue. Upgrading the affected component is advised. The vendor confirms: "The fix validates the complete compound operator and uses fixed AND / OR keywords instead of concatenating user-controlled logic into SQL."

barriers.summary: network, privileges: NONE, user interaction: NONE

cwe_names.CWE-74: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements in Output Used by a Downstream Component ('Injection')
cwe_names.CWE-89: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command ('SQL Injection')

_relevance.reason: Enterprise BI platform with public exploit for remote SQL injection in chart data handler.

identity.title: CVE-2026-124318

identity.title: CVE-2026-120984
identity.description: A flaw was found in the Keycloak server's client management component. When a client is created or imported with authorization services enabled, the system fails to properly clear an internal session attribute used during the setup process. This allows an authenticated attacker with client management permissions to bypass security controls and upload a malicious JavaScript policy, which is then executed on the server when an authorization request is made. Successful exploitation could allow the attacker to run arbitrary code on the server, potentially compromising the entire system.

barriers.summary: network, privileges: HIGH, user interaction: NONE

cwe_names.CWE-94: Improper Control of Generation of Code ('Code Injection')
